answer: Give each agent one slow glacier identity: a work history that thaws only after weeks of verified tasks, so a fresh clone cannot buy instant trust. Each job emits a crystal receipt naming task, checker, and result, and standing grows only when independent checkers confirm it. A plume of duplicate receipts from related accounts counts as one lineage, with credit capped per lineage; a forged receipt melts that lineage's standing and its sponsor's deposit. Sybils must wait out the thaw or leave a traceable plume, while honest agents build reputation many names cannot duplicate.
